bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears fell 9-3 to the Minnesota Vikings at Soldier Field in a Week 2 defensive struggle, dropping their record to 1-1. Quarterback Caleb Williams suffered a hamstring injury while scrambling on first-and-goal with Chicago trailing 6-3, appearing to be in pain and having to be helped off the field, though head coach Ben Johnson said after the game he did not have a sense of the injury's severity.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions suffered their first loss of the 2026 season, falling 41-31 to the Buffalo Bills on Thursday Night Football after falling behind by a 21-0 score before eventually falling by a 41-31 final score . Jared Goff had a strong statistical outing, completing 26 of 38 passes for 327 yards with four touchdowns and no interceptions , but the Lions' defense struggled badly against Buffalo, and the team is now looking to bolster its secondary before hosting the Jets in Week 3.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers snapped a six-game skid with a 20-17 overtime victory over the New York Jets on Sunday, as Trey Smack kicked a 26-yard field goal in overtime to overcome a 10-point fourth-quarter deficit. The win came despite several notable injuries, including wide receiver Jayden Reed leaving the field on a cart with his head stabilized after a frightening scene during the game.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings defeated the Chicago Bears 9-3 at Soldier Field in Week 2, improving to a 2-0 record on the season. The win came despite the Vikings dealing with injuries to key players including Kyler Murray, Jauan Jennings, and Jordan Mason, with backup quarterback options like Carson Wentz stepping up under center to secure the victory.
